justification: GDP per capita can improve through 2040 while unemployment rises through labor-force participation, productivity and sectoral composition; 2050 decline reflects scarring.
The 2040 and 2050 declines are consistent with earlier unemployment deterioration and medium structural scarring.
A 21.8% 2025-2050 real decline is severe but remains below collapse-scale analogues; it is compatible with high unemployment if shocks cluster.
